escalation.scope: repeat every candidate in the matched comparison
escalation.trigger: any matched P99 across-process CV exceeds 10% after initial stage

decision_protocol.pilot: one fresh process with 500 observations per publisher
decision_protocol.stop: stop after the initial stage when all matched P99 CV values are at most 10%; otherwise stop after escalation and label remaining high-variance results inconclusive

experiment.independent_repetition: rerun this command in a fresh process

results.latency_timer: perf_counter_ns around EventBus.publish; timer overhead included
results.lock_timer: perf_counter_ns around each underlying RLock acquisition and hold
